notes.title: Animation Overhaul, Combat Tweaks & Storytelling Push
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

This update has been a long time coming, and I’m excited to finally share it with you!

⚙️ Under-the-Hood Changes

A lot of this update won't be immediately visible, but it's important. The game’s codebase has grown a lot, and I’ve spent time cleaning things up and rewriting systems (especially animation handling) to make development smoother and more scalable. This sets me up better for future content and stability.

🎥 Narrative & Cutscenes

Since the beginning, this game has always been about telling a story. With this update, I’ve added short cutscenes to several stages to better deliver what's going on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/3fc0fce87e868283476158cee8d15888372be5ec.jpg

🕹️ Animation & Combat Overhaul

This is the most visible change in the update, and I hope it makes a big difference to how the game feels.

 All player character animations updated
 Combat animations are up to 2x faster, making things feel more deliberate and action-oriented
 New dodge mechanic with short i-frames
 Combat stance system that dynamically adjusts based on enemy presence
 IK rigging so the Earth Blade is now properly held and looks more grounded


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/1119c86cd475f651ae27c287d47c846b41e801cd.jpg

🎯 Camera & Reticle Improvements

 Improved the camera system to reduce jitter and feel smoother in movement
 Introduced a new reticle system for better feedback and targeting


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/81d635a3f751a005963b38cb05e763b71a0bc13b.jpg

🎨 UI & Options Menu Updates

 Switched to sliders for post-processing settings
 Added more visual customization options to help players tune the experience to their liking


🐞 Bug Fixes

 A ton of them. Seriously. Thanks to everyone who reported issues. I read everything!


If you’ve played the new version, I’d really love to hear what you think. The best way to share feedback is actually through the in-game feedback tool. That way, I can track things more directly and act on them faster.

More to come soon!

- Alex

notes.title: Playtest Recap: Feedback, Fixes, and Features
notes.content:
Thank You, Playtesters! 🎮

I just wanted to take a moment to thank all of you amazing playtesters who have tried out my game over the past two weeks. Your time, feedback, and willingness to share your data have been incredibly helpful in making improvements.

One of the tools I built for this playtest is a "Graveyard" heatmap that tracks where player deaths occur. It’s been a fantastic resource for identifying problem areas, like the "Air" stage, which had a lot of player deaths (including one rage-quit—oops!). Using this data, I’ve made tweaks to make this stage more balanced and enjoyable.

Here’s a preview of the heatmap in action:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/d7190bccc6c39532e01a3db51ae1b7e8eafc61cc.png


I’ve also added a few new features to make the game better:


 Steam Cloud Saves: Your progress is now backed up and safe in the cloud.
 Crash Reporting: The game can now send crash logs to help me identify and fix issues.
 "Restart from Checkpoint" Option: You can now easily retry challenging sections—or get unstuck if you encounter a problem.
 Voice (Grunt) Sound Slider: Control how loud the grunt sounds are.
 Auto Mute and Pause: Music is muted and the game pauses when you navigate away from the game window.


I’ve also squashed a ton of bugs, including:


 Defined the player start position as a checkpoint to avoid unnecessary scene reloads and stat resets.
 Fixed scenarios where players could get stuck.
 Prevented "jumping up" into inaccessible areas.
 Healing output now adjusts correctly based on difficulty.
 Fixed cooldown management for the Meteor Fire ability.
 Limited sliding to tilted terrain and on top of other characters only.
 Fixed casting area abilities on buildings and cliffs.
 Lightning ability now consistently hits foes in all scenarios.
 Resolved softlocks caused by resetting elemental charges after death.
 Fixed UI display for non-conventional (upright) display resolutions.


Thank you again for your support, patience, and feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts—I’m listening and working hard to make this the best experience it can be!

Here my updated Feedback Survey: https://form.jotform.com/250132202070334


Cheers,
Alex

notes.title: I Need Your Feedback! Beta Playtest Now Live
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I’m thrilled to share the Demo Playtest for my game, Arcane Whispers: The Last Stand! This is my very first playtest build, and it’s your chance to explore the demo level, dive into the world I’ve been creating, and help me make the game even better.

As a solo developer, I handle every aspect of the game, so your feedback is incredibly valuable to me. Right now, I’m particularly looking for input on:


 Character movement: How does it feel?
 Level progression and pacing: Does it flow well?
 Overall gameplay experience: What stands out, good or bad?

The game menu UI, animations, and special effects are still a work in progress, so I’d love for you to focus on the core gameplay when sharing your thoughts.


How to Share Your Feedback

You can:

 Fill out this feedback form: https://form.jotform.com/250042425133341
 Use the in-game feedback feature to share your thoughts while they’re fresh.


Not Sure What to Say? Start Here!

To help guide your feedback, here are some questions to think about:

 Was it clear how to play the game, or did you feel lost at any point?
 Did the game feel fair? Were there any moments that felt frustrating or confusing? What caused that?
 What was your favorite moment while playing?
 How would you describe the game to a friend?
 What did you spend most of your time doing in the game?
 Was there something you really wanted to try or do in the game, but couldn’t?

I’d also love to hear anything else you’d like to share—every bit of feedback helps!


Thank You!

Thank you so much for taking the time to try my game. Your feedback will play a huge role in shaping the future of Arcane Whispers: The Last Stand. I’m so excited to hear what you think!

notes.title: Major Graphics Overhaul: A New Visual Experience
notes.content:
Main Character Model Refresh

Enhanced Design: The main character model now has a lower poly count for a cleaner, more cohesive look that fits well with the low-poly environment. The mesh has been refined with smoother, rounded shapes to prevent the character from looking out of place.
Character Detail: Subtle vines now adorn the character’s body, adding a sense of depth and personality. A revised color palette employs contrasting hues to help the character stand out against the background, improving visibility and immersion.
Key Color Theme: Purple, featured prominently in the character’s armor, was chosen to evoke an "arcane" feel. This central color now appears across various elements in the visual overhaul, enhancing the game’s mystical atmosphere.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/5327f8f38b6ae5005514d0b79d540b8a2f9e40c3.png

Revamped User Interface

Streamlined Layout: The UI has been simplified to eliminate unnecessary visual clutter, resulting in a cleaner, more intuitive layout. The "Elemental Picker" now integrates seamlessly with the ability bar, ensuring a cohesive user experience.
Interactive Elements: Key interactive elements in the world are now highlighted with a subtle pink tone for easy identification.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/afdf79b1d68ee31b5465381fa712ddfc9b3e7b7c.png

Art Style Overhaul for the „Earth“ (green) and „Fire“ (red) stages

Enhanced Terrain and Flora: The terrain has been redesigned with double the polygon count for the floating islands, adding depth and eliminating flatness. Flora has been updated to create a mysterious, fantasy-like atmosphere.
New Color Palette: Soft pastel colors now define the “Earth” and “Fire” stages, allowing the character and other key elements, with their more saturated tones, to stand out clearly against the environment.
Enriched Environments: The game world now includes more objects overall, such as grass patches, flowers, bushes, rocks, and mysterious central areas with trees and ruins—creating a richer, more inhabited atmosphere.
Improved Lighting: A three-point lighting setup enhances shadows and adds visual depth, creating more appealing and immersive scenes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247884/39a62616b1810a374ed41d68b82f58251414184c.png

This update enhances both the visual appeal and functionality of the game, aiming to provide an engaging and immersive experience as players explore this dynamic world.
